system.biography:
Giant owls are nocturnal birds of prey, feared for their ability to hunt and attack in near silence. They are intelligent, and though naturally suspicious, sometimes associate with good creatures. A typical giant owl stands about 9 feet tall, has a wingspan of up to 20 feet, and resembles its smaller cousins in nearly every way except size.

Giant owls speak Common and Sylvan.

Combat

A giant owl attacks by gliding silently just a few feet above its prey and plunging to strike when directly overhead.

Superior Low-Light Vision (Ex)

A giant owl can see five times as far as a human can in dim light.

Skills

Giant owls have a +8 racial bonus on Listen checks and a +4 racial bonus on Spot checks.

*When in flight, giant owls gain a +8 bonus on Move Silently checks.

Training A Giant Owl

Although intelligent, a giant owl requires training before it can bear a rider in combat. To be trained, a giant owl must have a friendly attitude toward the trainer (this can be achieved through a successful Diplomacy check). Training a friendly giant owl requires six weeks of work and a DC 25 Handle Animal check. Riding a giant owl requires an exotic saddle. A giant owl can fight while carrying a rider, but the rider cannot also attack unless he or she succeeds on a Ride check.

Giant owl eggs are worth 2,500 gp apiece on the open market, while chicks are worth 4,000 gp each. Professional trainers charge 1,000 gp to rear or train a giant owl.

Carrying Capacity

A light load for a giant owl is up to 300 pounds; a medium load, 301-600 pounds; and a heavy load, 601-900 pounds.

system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Listen checks and Spot checks.

system.description: Animals, fey, giants, monstrous humanoids, plants, seasons and cycles, weather, vermin. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Make a Move Silently check when you try to sneak past enemies or move without being heard.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.

What it does (SRD): In starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar dim lighting, the creature can see twice as far as a human can in the same light. It retains the ability to distinguish color and detail under those conditions that a human could not.

ThirdEra: Low-light vision is set on this item’s Details tab under Capability grants (vision and senses), not in Mechanical effects (no extra distance is needed for the usual reading of the rule). The character sheet includes it with other vision from items and race.

items.name: Giant Owl — Superior Low-Light Vision & Skills

system.description:
Superior low-light vision (Ex): Sees five times as far as a human in dim light.

Skills: +8 racial on Listen, +4 on Spot; +8 on Move Silently while in flight.

Training: Intelligent; train as magical beasts with DC 23 (young) or 26 (egg) per Handle Animal (SRD).

What it does (SRD): The creature can see in total darkness out to the distance set on this copy (default from the stat block). Darkvision is black and white only unless another rule says otherwise.

ThirdEra: Distance is under CGS parameters and overrides on this item (merged over the canonical template). The stat block’s distance is preserved when migrating from older packs.
